DATA & SOURCES

KNOW WHAT
STAYS WHERE.

The public website explains retrieval. Your garment archive and model run in your own installed workspace.

The public website.

These pages serve static HTML, CSS, JavaScript, self-hosted fonts and licensed photographs. Crumble adds no analytics, advertising pixels, account registration or contact-form collection. The hosting provider may keep delivery or access logs under its own policies.

The sample archive filters four local example records by their names and category. It does not upload photographs, create embeddings or call a similarity-search model. Opening an original source or GitHub follows that service's privacy policy.

The current pages do not save review drafts or costs. Older versions may have left a local review draft in your browser; browser site-data controls can remove it.

Your installed archive.

Imported garment metadata, source snapshots, processed image files, embeddings and search indexes live in your configured workspace. They are not submitted to this public website.

The fashion model is downloaded from its publisher when first configured. Once installed, the supplied encoder processes image queries in your application environment. A remote deployment follows the access and storage settings you configure.

The project does not include your brand's private catalogue or automatically scrape retailer websites. Supply licensed local images and metadata, and keep original image files in your own asset system. Read the deployment guide before exposing a workspace beyond your machine.

Real photographs & credits.

The four garment photographs were published by Reistor on Unsplash. Their source pages list camera metadata and the Unsplash License, which permits commercial and non-commercial use. We resized and converted the photographs to WebP; page layouts may crop them. We did not generate or change the garments.

  • Beige hemp dress / front view — Reistor. Published 2025-05-16.
  • Off-white hemp shirt / construction detail — Reistor. Published 2025-07-18.
  • Blue floral dress / reclining view — Reistor. Published 2025-06-13.
  • Striped dress / back detail and homepage hero — Reistor. Published 2025-06-13.

The garment names come from the source descriptions. Visible details are manually reviewed photo observations, not model output. A detail outside a photo's view remains unknown. These separate garments do not establish copying, chronology or brand influence. Reistor is credited as the photo source, not presented as a Crumble customer or sponsor.

Photo rights remain under the Unsplash License. Apache-2.0 covers the project code, not these photographs. See the photo source manifest and repository third-party notices.

Project questions.

Use GitHub issues for project questions and the security policy for private vulnerability reports. Keep private catalogue data and credentials out of public reports.
